title: Mouth Bubbles
desc: You started blowing the most delightful little bubbles with your mouth, completely absorbed in this new skill you had stumbled upon. It was messy, it was adorable, and you were very proud of yourself.
story: It started with a small, accidental sound and then you felt it, something bubbly and interesting happening right there in your own mouth, and you were immediately obsessed. You would blow and pause, feeling the sensation, then do it all over again with total concentration on your face. Everything around you could wait, because this was clearly the most important research you had ever conducted. We watched you with big smiles, chins resting in our hands, wondering what on earth was going on in that brilliant little head of yours.
